entries.0f84e7da655996c3: The company manufactures and sells asphalt products and others, performs intermediate treatment (recycling) of industrial waste, sells other construction materials, and runs a food and beverage business (operating conveyor-belt sushi restaurants), among others. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥446 million, broken down into ¥164 million from manufacturing and sales, ¥218 million from food and beverage, and ¥64 million from other. The non-consolidated subsidiary Hashidate Namakonkurito Kogyo Co., Ltd. operates a ready-mixed concrete manufacturing and sales business, Sogo Giken Co., Ltd. operates a construction consulting business, and ＰＦＩ Maizuru Jodanchi Co., Ltd. performs maintenance of public housing.
